svg.title: Level 1 DFD - Budget Tracker
svg.text: Generated expenses (one per template and month)
Same-ID stores drawn more than once (D1, D2, D3, D5) are one store, repeated so every flow stays straight.
D1 Accounts stands for the users, sessions and account-settings tables.
Every request carries the session token; each user reads and writes only their own rows.
Balance is derived all-time: opening balance minus expenses minus goal savings. Expense saves return overspend and low-balance alerts.
